t: You're at the Fox and Anchor, a Grade II listed pub at 115 Charterhouse Street in Farringdon. It was designed by Latham Withall, a British architect who lived from 1853 to 1925. Before this, he practised in Adelaide, South Australia, between 1876 and 1888. He was later awarded the OBE. The material here says little else about the building, so take in the pub's frontage and its listed status, and remember that it is the work of an architect who started his career on the other side of the world.
